cpuThrottle.scope: openProbe and after-open counters precede CPU throttling; subsequent netplay setup and first game callback use the configured per-side rates.

scope: Recorded API/handler/copy boundaries. FIFO occurrence matching uses all header fields plus length, FNV32 and destination. The hash is not collision-proof; duplicate occurrences remain explicit.
limitations: No OS receive or actual NIC transmit timestamps. WebSocket send entry/return bracket the API call, not physical send.
poll-copy means bytes copied into WASM, not per-packet protocol acceptance. Safe frontier can reflect several dequeues.
An already requested RAF entering late does not identify the unobserved browser/compositor/task source. No antivirus causal claim follows from this record.
Host aggregate CPU does not measure individual-core scheduling/frequency. Process snapshots miss short exited tasks.
Relay trace stops after browser result capture; unmatched tail events outside browser observation are retained.

activeEpisode.selection: Largest pending game RAF after an active sample; all startup and other delayed RAF records remain in allRafPendingOver250ms.

audio.limitation: The audio probe omits its wall-clock origin. Window alignment is inferred from measure.started/audioStart and AudioContext time; callback-relative gaps are directly observed.

conclusions.causeBoundary: The report does not identify which browser/compositor or injected task caused RAF dispatch to wait. Host load and unrelated security instrumentation are not proof of that cause.
conclusions.startup: Every >250ms RAF request delay remains listed, including pre-active startup intervals. Selecting the active episode does not delete startup observations.
